_about: How Magic Users build their spell lists: a caster picks a plan (a doctrine) and buys toward it, instead of buying whatever scores well on its own. Each doctrine has a stance (what it is for on the field), a play style (how the simulator plays it), a core list bought first in order, spells it leans toward or away from, and set-up-and-finish combos. Archetype doctrines exist only at 6th level: the Archetype is bought first and the list is built around what it allows. Doctrine choice: below 6th level a caster picks a base doctrine by `share`; at 6th level each Archetype doctrine is taken by `share_at_6` of that class's players (0.4 in total per class) and the rest pick a base doctrine by `share`. Everything in this file except slugs, costs and Archetype rules is an ASSUMPTION about how real players build: the shares especially. Please correct it.

stances.offense: Gets kills itself: Magic Balls and lethal Verbals.
stances.control: Takes enemies out of the fight so teammates can kill them or survive: Stopped, Frozen, Stunned, Suppressed, forced movement, disarming.
stances.support: Makes teammates better: weapon Enchantments that arm fighters, armor and protection Enchantments that keep them alive, tempo abilities that refill their uses.
stances.sustain: Undoes losses: heals, revives, repairs, removes States.
stances.hybrid: Fights in the line with weapons and self-buffs, casting when there is a moment.

play_styles.striker: Stays behind the line and throws or casts at whoever can be killed.
play_styles.controller: Stays behind the line and locks down the enemy most dangerous to a teammate: one engaged with an ally first, then the strongest fighter in range. Kills only when nothing needs locking down.
play_styles.enchanter: Enchants teammates before the fight and at base, re-enchants between fights, then heals and cleanses. Casts at enemies last.
play_styles.medic: Heals and revives teammates from just behind the line; never walks into melee to do it.
play_styles.battle: Fights in melee like a fighter, keeps self-buffs up, and casts only when free.

Wizard.name: Artillery
Wizard.why: The kill-it-yourself Wizard: carries as many Magic Balls as the points allow and throws them from behind the line.

Wizard.name: Battlefield controller
Wizard.why: Stops, Freezes and Suppresses the enemies fighting its teammates. It rarely gets the kill; the fighter next to the target does.

Wizard.name: Lock-down and finish
Wizard.why: Uses its own control spell to set up its own kill: Stop then Dragged Below, Freeze then Shatter, Fragile then any wound.

Wizard.name: Armorer
Wizard.why: Arms and protects one or two fighters (Contagion or Void Touched on the best fighter, Blessing Against Harm on the front line) and keeps their gear working.

Wizard.name: Battlemage
Wizard.why: No Enchantments or Magic Balls, but Ambulant becomes unlimited: a Verbal caster who casts while moving, so the lock-down-and-finish chain works on the run.

Wizard.name: Evoker
Wizard.why: Elemental Barrage becomes Charge x10 and 20'/50' Verbals are off the table: all points go into Magic Balls thrown without incanting.

Wizard.name: Warlock
Wizard.why: Death and Flame Verbals and Balls give double uses and nothing else may be bought: Lightning Bolt Stops, Dragged Below kills the Stopped, Fireball and Finger of Death kill outright, all twice as often.

Healer.name: Field medic
Healer.why: Keeps the team's players alive and in the fight: heals, revives and cleanses from just behind the line.

Healer.name: Protector
Healer.why: Protects fighters before they get hurt: Resistances, Immunities and equipment protection cast at base on the front line.

Healer.name: Battle healer
Healer.why: Stands in the line with weapon and shield, heals the fighters beside it, and Stops or Freezes whoever pushes in.

Healer.name: Warder
Healer.why: Protection School abilities give double uses, and Death, Command and Subdual are off the table: the Protector with twice the Enchantments and no control.

Healer.name: Priest
Healer.why: Heal is free and Meta-Magic becomes 1/Life Charge x3 but only on Spirit abilities: Swift Heals and Resurrects, cast while moving.

Healer.name: Necromancer
Healer.why: Death School abilities become Charge x3 and up to five Undead Minions: revives the same fighters again and again. No Protection School.

Druid.name: Enchanter
Druid.why: Turns fighters into better fighters: Magic Armor, Shield Crushing and Wounds Kill weapons, death prevention. Attuned and Essence Graft let one fighter carry more.

Druid.name: Elementalist
Druid.why: Stops and Freezes enemies with Entangle, Icy Blast and Iceball and disarms them with Heat Weapon; Force Bolt and Call Lightning when there is a kill to take.

Druid.name: Battle druid
Druid.why: Fights with weapon and shield and supports the line from inside it.

Druid.name: Summoner
Druid.why: Each Enchantment gives double uses, no 20'/50' Verbals, no equipment past 2nd level: a pure enchanter with twice the supply.

Druid.name: Avatar of Nature
Druid.why: Its Enchantments of 4th level and below become Self: the Druid enchants itself and fights.

Druid.name: Ranger
Druid.why: Uses bows, equipment is free and Enchantments cost double: shoots, and spends its points on Balls and Verbals.

Bard.name: Controller
Bard.why: Insult pulls an enemy off a teammate, Awe and Terror keep attackers off, Stun and Suppress Aura take a fighter or caster out.

Bard.name: Force multiplier
Bard.why: Refills teammates' abilities (Empower, Restoration, Confidence), speeds their Charges (Song of Power), and heals through Battlefield Triage.

Bard.name: Skald
Bard.why: Fights in the line while chanting: Song of Battle makes their weapons Armor Breaking; the defensive songs keep them standing.

Bard.name: Combat caster
Bard.why: No empty hand needed to cast: the Skald who Stuns and Awes mid-fight without dropping weapon or shield.

Bard.name: Dervish
Bard.why: Each Verbal gives double uses and equipment costs double: the Controller with twice the Stuns, Awes and Suppressions.

Bard.name: Legend
Bard.why: Each Extension gives double uses and Swift is off the table: 20' control cast from 50'.
